name: Acyclovir 400 mg 35 tablets
description: Acyclovir is used to reduce pain and speed the healing of wounds or blisters in people who have chickenpox, herpes zoster (shingles; a skin rash that can occur in people who have had chickenpox), and in those who have new or repeat outbreaks of herpes. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
